test_title: PYST 49: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 3% per month in 4 months.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,200

Rate of interest (R) = 3% per month

Time (T) = 4 months

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (₹1,200 × 3 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = ₹14,400 ÷ 100

⇒ SI = ₹144

**∴ The correct answer is ₹144.**
